title: EcoBoost Fuel Specifications
introduction:
I start with the EcoBoost/GTDi rows, then read the operating condition before the specification. The fuel-pressure entry applies with the engine running and covers only the low-pressure side. The neighboring Duratec and Ti-VCT entries retain their own engine applicability.

Tank capacity describes how much the tank holds; it does not establish fuel-delivery pressure. A full tank gives the pump no automatic clean bill of health. Read each value with its printed unit, and keep the paired units together as representations of the same specification. This page supplies reference values, not gauge connections, pressure-release instructions or a diagnostic decision tree. Use the matching engine procedure before opening the fuel system or measuring pressure.

edits.why: Choose the row by engine and operating condition before comparing a reading. The low-pressure qualifier prevents treating the EcoBoost entry as a specification for its entire injection system. Capacity and pressure describe different things; neither identifies a failed component by itself.
